newsitem.title: UK: Moorfield buys out joint venture partners.
newsitem.headline: Moorfield buys out joint venture partners.

text.p: British property development company Moorfield Estates Plc, which has been involved in a bid to restructure sector rival Greycoat Plc, said on Thursday it had acquired the outstanding interests in three joint venture development partnerships for 2.5 million stg cash.
Moorfield said in a statement that the trio's potential would be further enhanced by gaining full control.

"Moorfield intends to take each development opportunity to construction stage at which point the directors will then decide how the projects should be progressed for the greatest benefit of Moorfield shareholders," the company said.
Payment for the three stakes will be made through an initial 1.0 million stg now and a further 1.5 million stg no later than January 31, 1997.
The three projects are all in northern England.
